message.name: AgentCANotificationCancellationRequestV01
message.definition: Scope|This message is sent by an issuer (or its agent) to a CSD to request the cancellation of a notification advice message.|Usage|When this message is used to request the cancellation of a notification advice message, the function of the message must be cancellation.|When this message is used to request the withdrawal of a Corporate Action event or option, then the function of the message must be withdrawal.|In both cases, the building block notification advice identification must be present to link this cancellation request to the notification advice that was previously sent.

rules.name: DomesticOrProprietaryIdentificationSourceRule
rules.text: Either DomesticIdentificationSource or ProprietaryIdentificationSource must be present, but not both.

rules.name: DomesticOrProprietaryIdentificationSourceRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either DomesticIdentificationSource or ProprietaryIdentificationSource must be present, but not both.

rules.name: ISINOrOtherIdentificationRule
rules.text: Either ISIN or OtherIdentification must be present but not both.

rules.name: ISINOrOtherIdentificationRuleNotBoth
rules.text: Either ISIN or OtherIdentification must be present but not both.

rules.name: ChangeAllowedRule
rules.text: If the value of ChangeAllowedIndicator is true, then PerdioDetails/RevocabilityPeriod is Mandatory.

rules.name: WithdrawalAllowedRule
rules.text: If the value of WithdrawalAllowedIndicator is true, then PeriodDetails/RevocabilityPeriod is Mandatory.
